proposals.title: Use a verified public-state plan, then confirm all faces
proposals.trigger: A cube observation or prerequisite planning advice is available.
procedure: Read all six current face arrays and their centers. Treat center labels as current orientation; do not assume original labels stayed fixed after a cube rotation.

If prerequisite GateSchedule advice returns status planned and a nonempty path, submit those exact legal moves through the native turn action, splitting only at the native move-count limit. Do not replace a verified plan with an unrelated remembered algorithm.
Re-read the resulting public faces. If all nine stickers on each of all six faces agree, submit finish. A plan is not terminal evidence; the environment must confirm completion.

If the helper reports search_limit or not_found_within_depth, it has not proved impossibility. Use concise layer-by-layer progress from the current state or request a larger admissible bounded search; avoid restarting a long full solution derivation in one response.
If actual feedback contradicts the supplied forward model, stop relying on that plan and diagnose move/orientation semantics before more irreversible actions.
invariants: Only current public state and public legal moves; no stored scramble, fixed solution or case identifier.
Do not finish merely because a subset of faces is uniform.
successSignals: All six public faces are uniform and native finish reports success.
recovery: Continue from current faces, not an imagined prior arrangement.
